actions.description: Test durable acceptance through worker and API restarts
actions.command:
set -eu
job='durability-check-20260815'
systemctl stop queue-worker.service
response=$(printf 'unicode payload: café / 雪' | curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST --data-binary @- -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' -w '\n%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$job")
printf '%s\n' "$response"
queued=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$job")
printf '%s\n' "$queued"
systemctl start queue-worker.service
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  result=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/$job")
  case "$result" in *'"status":"completed"'*) printf '%s\n' "$result"; break;; esac
  sleep 0.2
done
